format.description: Older transcript entries have no format; resolve them through the host's catalog.

group.description: The part of the app a design belongs to; the canvas lays out one row per group.

issueWorkspace.description: The Linear workspace the issue was picked from.

signingSecret.description: Webhook Routines: a new HMAC secret (write-only, never read back) and the header the signature comes in (null or blank: the default).
Webhook Routines: the HMAC secret, write-only (signs the Routine), and the header the signature comes in.

prompt.description: What the agent is sent: the body with the attached files listed.

sessionId.description: The chat to send to, or null for a new chat in the worktree.

body.description: The message as the chat shows it.

files.description: Paths of the files attached to the message.

fastMode.description: Claude only: faster Opus output at premium usage rates.

replies.description: How long Claude's replies run; Claude only, Codex ignores it.

tldrEnabled.description: Apply bundled TLDR writing rules to both providers. Defaults to true.

prAction.description: A PR-blocker pill's action. Milagre checks it and writes the body, prompt and context itself, ignoring the ones sent.

linearIssue.description: The first message of a Chat started from an issue. Milagre reads the issue and writes the body, prompt and context itself.

compact.description: Compact the Chat's context now (Claude only). Milagre writes the body, prompt and context itself, ignoring the ones sent.

dataUrl.description: Draft and legacy images use dataUrl; persisted images use path.

sourcePath.description: Original file attachment when path points at the durable image copy.

pin_order.description: Where a pinned chat sits among the pinned ones, lowest first. Kept when unpinned; only read while pinned.
